title: Merged Historical Overlay · Measurement-First Input Contract
subtitle: Measured-input contract retained in the current runtime
banner: MERGED HISTORICAL OVERLAY, not a separate runtime · retained as change evidence; the measured-input contract is part of the current runtime.
summary: Replace the Croce-constrained entrance with the four-dataset unified measurement loader and make all teacher families optional sidecars.

changes.note: Use UnifiedPhysiologyWindowDataset for every newly planned experiment
Accept dataset-specific EEG channels with masks, geometry and provenance
Accept canonical HbO/HbR measurements without requiring a Croce observation split
Demote Croce cache from required entrance to a named derived target sidecar
Generalize to replaceable target families with scoped validation
Remove the fixed Croce r/s target shape from the architecture invariant
Remove the fixed Croce hemodynamic target shape from the architecture invariant
Keep teacher-free losses active and enable auxiliary losses only by named target family
